review_candidates.title: Senior Database Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Design and implement database schemas, tables, indexes, and other objects to support application requirements. Implement and maintain database security controls and policies to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access or disclosure. Troubleshoot database-related problems, working closely with application developers and system administrators to resolve issues in a timely manner. Maintain comprehensive documentation of database configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps. Qualific
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Design and implement database schemas, tables, indexes, and other objects to support application requirements. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master's degree preferred). 3 years of experience as a database administrator, with a focus on managing large-scale database environments. Proficiency in database technologies such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.
